import array,struct,time
MASK=(1<<64)-1
# tables
P=[1]
for i in range(1,10):P.append((P[-1]*257)&MASK)
# pair value big-endian (b0<<8|b1) contribution b0*257+b1 (where b digits are +1)
# We'll precompute for pair16 x: high byte h=x>>8, low=x&255: (h+1)*257+(l+1)
pair=[0]*65536
for x in range(65536):
 pair[x]=(((x>>8)+1)*257 + ((x&255)+1))&MASK
scaled=[[0]*65536 for _ in range(4)]
# position within 8 bytes: pair index0 weight257^6, 1 ->257^4,2->257^2,3->1
for j,w in enumerate([6,4,2,0]):
 t=scaled[j]; pw=P[w]
 for x in range(65536):t[x]=(pair[x]*pw)&MASK
# data
d=(b'a'*8190)*1024
print('size',len(d))
def fp1(data):
 h=0
 for b in data:h=(h*257+b+1)&MASK
 return h
def fp4(data):
 h=0; P4=P[4]
 t0,t1,t2,t3=scaled
 # struct iter_unpack
 it=struct.iter_unpack('>4H',data)
 for a,b,c,d in it:
  h=(h*P4 + t0[a]+t1[b]+t2[c]+t3[d])&MASK
 return h
# better combine inner sum mask once? addition 4 values no huge (scaled masked), can mask after
def fp4b(data):
 h=0; P4=P[4]
 t0,t1,t2,t3=scaled
 for a,b,c,d in struct.iter_unpack('>4H',data):
  h=((h*P4) + t0[a]+t1[b]+t2[c]+t3[d])&MASK
 return h
def fp8(data):
 h=0;P8=P[8]
 t0,t1,t2,t3=scaled
 for x in struct.iter_unpack('>Q',data):
  h=(h*P8 + t0[x>>48]+t1[(x>>32)&65535]+t2[(x>>16)&65535]+t3[x&65535])&MASK
 return h
